successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Trarza, the south-western Mauritanian emirate on the north bank of the Senegal river from Rosso to the Atlantic, with the Chemama (the page gives no outline; the gazetteer's Trarza region stands for…

ledger.x: c. 1640: the Trarza confederation is founded. Infobox "Confederation founded: 1640"; "c.1640 Trarza confederation founded", "in the midst of the final wars between the local nomadic Berbers and the Arab Hassanis tribes".
15 December 1902: Trarza becomes a French protectorate.
December 1902: the independent emirate ends under the protectorate (the page gives no end date; the dynasty continues to 1932).

wars.name: Franco-Trarzan War of 1825
wars.outcome: "The French initiated the Franco-Trarzan War of 1825 with a large expeditionary force that crushed Muhammad's army."

wars.name: Battle of Jubuldu
wars.outcome: 25 February 1855: "At the Battle of Jubuldu... the French defeated a combined Waalo and Moorish force"; Trarza "almost took Saint-Louis in a raid in 1855, but the French punitive expedition was swift and decisive".

certainty.note: The page gives no outline; the Trarza region stands for it.
